records.name: Explicit human mode selects shipped arena; one PvP seat waits with 8 Infantry per side
Two humans receive the first ordinary 15-second two-Infantry wave without paying resources
Due waves fill to 12 supply, then expire at cap without queueing a burst
Six authoritative enemy troop deaths credit once and visibly unlock future Rider waves
Saved mode and kill ledger beat fresh omission; a Rider costs two supply and is delivered by a later wave
Losing every troop does not defeat a living core; its next wave repopulates the side
Actual lethal structure combat defeats an army-bearing side; restored result freezes waves, score and clock
Both original cores receive lethal damage in the same combat tick and draw
Host rematch retains mode while resetting cores, evolution, receipts and wave schedule
Unsupported mode-state version is retained byte-for-byte, never reinterpreted
Rider roster without earned evolution is retained byte-for-byte, never reinterpreted
Technology outside the zero-economy mode is retained byte-for-byte, never reinterpreted
Friendly troop target that could award false kill credit is retained byte-for-byte, never reinterpreted
Damaged opening before the human clock starts is retained byte-for-byte, never reinterpreted
Explicit one-human Practice starts the same mode without inventing an AI controller

limits: First wave uses ordinary connected play. Later timer/cap and lethal combat boundaries use deliberate valid checkpoint fixtures.
Blocked-spawn expiry and receipt reuse/wrap are pure rule checks; no rendered, deployed, AI or balance acceptance claim.
